caption: The drawing is of a ceramic jar with a lid and two curved handles, both resembling bamboo and colored in a pale off-white with subtle yellow accents. The main body and lid of the jar are blue. On the surface of the jar is a decorative motif featuring two birds, one white with black markings and the other brown with black markings, positioned among foliage. The foliage consists of various large and small leaves in brown, green, and yellow, pink berries, and several pink flowers with yellow centers. The jar has a rounded shape and the handles arc outward from the body on each side. The artist's signature, "Hugh Clarke," appears in the lower right corner of the drawing, which is centered on a plain, off-white background with a rectangular border.
title: Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
